quotes.text: I returned to hand-written notebooks. None of these knowledge management frameworks ever worked for me. Sure my agents have their own semantic memory system but I'm not an agent.
quotes.author: bauerd
quotes.source: Hacker News — Note-Taking and Personal Knowledge Management
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect grug quote — rejecting all the fancy frameworks and AI-powered systems to go back to paper. The punchline 'I'm not an agent' is genuinely funny and cuts through the AI hype cleanly.
